description: Free a membership slot so a Telegram account can join or create a group. Accounts have a hard ceiling on channels plus supergroups, and at the ceiling both creating and joining fail with an error that misleadingly blames the target chat. Finds the least-valuable current memberships, proposes what to leave, and retries the join. Triggers: "/tg-slot", "cannot join the group", "free a telegram slot".
